description.value:
You single out up to three creatures you can see within range, each of which must succeed on a Charisma saving throw. The first time each affected creature makes an attack roll or saving throw before the power ends, it must roll a d4 and subtract the result.

Cast with a slot of 3rd level or higher, you can add one additional target for every two slot levels beyond 1st, and the die used increases to a d6 at 3rd level, a d8 at 6th level, and a d10 at 9th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 1
